==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I charged up my Lucid Light until my body became Lucid Light. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.)
Johnson tried to do the same, but he could only create a light aura of Lucid Light around himself. (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.)
We flew over the village to help him learn how to better control his newfound power.
